title: Not fixing data types in Power Query
description_of_error: Setting: The Power Query inside an Excel workbook was reading an external table if numbers and an IF statement assessed if the number was higher that a threshold. Inside the query, the column had the datatype left as Any". The external table contained a mixure of numbers and strings where the data was missing. Because VBA auto-detected datatypes
how_to_notice: it sometimes classified the column as ""string"". The problem was that a string is always evaluated as 1. Ex: ""0.01"">0.5 would evaluate as TRUE. "
timestamp: Always define the datatype in the Power Query.
